verdict.rationale: Terminal's own docs describe an API-based, server-driven integration and a built-in simulated card reader for developing and testing without physical hardware. That makes non-interactive, hardware-free automation plausible, and the Stripe CLI and sandboxes add command-line testing. Nothing explicitly documents running Terminal flows in CI pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless pipeline documentation for Terminal, scripted simulated-reader usage examples in CI, independent hands-on corroboration of automated test runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
The Stripe CLI helps you build, test, and manage your Stripe integration right from the terminal.
